meta.title: Join as a Provider — Blokpakt
meta.description: Apply to become a Blokpakt contractor. Set your services, coverage ZIP codes, and choose your activation path. Block Captain spots available.

hero.headline: Earn more. Drive less.
hero.subheadline: Blokpakt batches jobs by street so you spend less time driving and more time earning. Apply in under 3 minutes.

depositOption.title: Pay Activation Deposit
bullets: Priority dispatch in your ZIP codes

referralOption.title: Refer a Neighbor
bullets: Refer one homeowner who books a job
Activation unlocks when their job completes

blockCaptain.headline: Be the first contractor on your block
blockCaptain.description: The first provider to cover a ZIP code earns Block Captain status — priority dispatch, a profile badge, and a $50 bonus after your first 5 jobs in that zone.
perks: Block Captain badge on your profile

waitlist.headline: We're not in your area yet
waitlist.description: Blokpakt is expanding fast. Drop your info and we'll notify you the moment your ZIP code goes live — you'll get first-mover Block Captain status.
